headline: Go from acquisition thesis to a cited, defensible shortlist
capabilities: Convert the thesis into filters and weights in one conversation
Rank the passing companies and show how each score is built
Open cited dossiers and flag thin or stale evidence as research requests
Draft the screening memo, leaving approval to the team
outcomes: Moved from thesis to a ranked shortlist in a single working session
Gave the committee rankings it could audit and challenge
Started outreach only after evidence gaps were closed
why_try: The demo walks one thesis from criteria to a committee memo draft in six questions, with every score and source visible.

sample_prompts.label: Corporate Development Associate: Thesis to screening criteria
sample_prompts.prompt: We want to buy a profitable compliance-workflow software company in Europe within our revenue band. Turn that into a screen we can run.

sample_prompts.label: Corporate Development Associate: Ranked target longlist
sample_prompts.prompt: Run the screen and rank the companies that pass.

sample_prompts.label: Corporate Development Associate: Cited target dossier
sample_prompts.prompt: Give me the dossier on the top-ranked target, with its sources and diligence questions.

sample_prompts.label: Head of Corporate Development: Weighting challenge
sample_prompts.prompt: Does the ranking hold if we weight financial quality more heavily?

sample_prompts.label: Research Analyst: Evidence-gap review
sample_prompts.prompt: Where is our evidence thin or out of date?

sample_prompts.label: Head of Corporate Development: Investment committee memo draft
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the screening memo for the investment committee.

business_flow: Investment committee and corporate development lead
